en.text: The Monetary Policy Committee has [[1]] members and is chaired by the [[2]]. It sets the policy [[3]] rate with the aim of keeping CPI inflation at 4 per cent, within a band of [[4]] per cent either side. If votes are tied, the chair has a [[5]] vote.
en.why: Three members are from the RBI and three are appointed by the government. The Finance Minister is not a member. The repo rate, not the reverse repo, is the policy rate.
